events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Decision needed: migration paused after batch 3 because the new CRM incorrectly added +1 to phone numbers without country codes. Of 120 migrated records, 31 overseas customers have incorrect phone numbers; batches 4–10 would have the same problem. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so incorrect numbers may already be in use; affected users and record IDs are not provided in the validation notes. Recommend promptly warning the sales team not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, obtaining the affected record IDs and verified country codes, and correcting the import mapping before repairing those 31 records and resuming the remaining 280. Please arrange the mapping fix and verified phone data, and authorize the affected-record corrections.
